author: Jonathan Harrison
title: How to watch Minnesota athletes at the Winter Olympics on Thursday, Feb. 19 - NewsBreak
text:
By Jonathan Harrison ,
4 hours ago There will be 27 athletes with Minnesota connections in action on Thursday at the 2026 Winter Olympics. Eight could claim gold with the United States women's hockey team. Another Minnesotan is going for gold in men's speedskating. Here is how to watch on Thursday.
(Note: All times below are CT)
Women's curling Switzerland vs. USA - 7:05 a.m. - Peacock | Re-air: 8:30 p.m. CT - USA Network
The five-member U.S. women's curling team all are either Minnesota natives or have a connection to the state. Aileen Geving (Duluth), Cory Thiesse (Duluth), Tabitha Peterson Lovick (Eagan), and Tara Peterson (Eagan) are all native Minnesotans, while Tayler Anderson-Heide is a Gopher alumnus.
The United States enter the final day of play needing a win to qualify for the knockout rounds of the tournament. Currently the U.S. are in a three-way tie for third place, but sit on the outside looking in for the final two spots in the playoffs.
Switzerland, the United States' opponent, have already qualified in second place. The other two teams tied for third-place are Canada and South Korea, who play each other on Thursday.
With a win the U.S. will move on. However, if the U.S. were to lose while Canada also loses, the United States would go through on a head-to-head tiebreaker. If the U.S. loses and South Korea loses, then the United States would be out after losing to South Korea earlier in the tournament.
Women's hockey Bronze Medal Game: Switzerland vs. Sweden - 7:40 a.m. - Peacock | Re-air: 11 a.m.¬† 9 p.m. - USA Network
Gold Medal Game: USA vs. Canada - 12:10 p.m. - USA Network | Re-air: 10 p.m. USA Network
Thursday is medal day in the women's tournament with Switzerland taking on Sweden for bronze and the United States facing Canada for the gold medal. There are 17 Minnesota athletes involved between the four teams involved.
Switzerland: Laura Zimmermann (St. Cloud alumna), Lara Stalder (UMD alumna), Saskia Maurer (St. Thomas alumna)
Sweden: Josefin Bouveng (Gophers player), Ida Karlsson and Thea Johansson (UMD players), Emma Soderberg and Tindra Holm (UMD alumna)
Canada: Jocelyne Larocque (UMD alumna)
USA: Rory Guilday (Chanhassen), Taylor Heise (Lake City/Frost), Kelly Pannek (Plymouth/Frost), Lee Stecklein (Roseville/Frost), Grace Zumwinkle (Excelsior/Frost), Abbey Murphy (Gophers player), Kendall Coyne Schofield and Britta Curl-Salemme (Frost players)
Feb 16, 2026; Milan, Italy; Taylor Heise (27) of the United States takes a shot as Hanna Olsson (26) of Sweden defends during the first period in a women's ice hockey semifinal during the Milano Cortina 2026 Olympic Winter Games at Milano Santagiulia Ice Hockey Arena.Mandatory Credit: Katie Stratman-Imagn Images
Men's speedskating 1500km - 9:30 a.m. - USA Network | Re-air: 11:30 a.m. - NBC
Macalester alumnus Conor McDermott-Mostowy goes for gold in the men's speedskating 1500km. It is his final attempt for a medal.
